name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 47 – Am 29
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 47a. Calls for increased funding for research and innovation to include a strong component dedicated to sustainable agriculture, reducing water consumption and chemical inputs, improving soil fertility, developing crops resilient to climate change, and promoting the circular economy, energy efficient production processes and technologies accessible to SMEs and farmers;
